title: How do I message a neighbour?

contentBody.question: How do I message a neighbour?
contentBody.answer:
Open Messages and tap New to search for someone and start a conversation. You can also tap Message on a neighbour's profile.

To keep everyone safe, sharing works in one direction. You can start a conversation with a neighbour once they have shared their contact info with you, and they can always reply. Sharing your own details does not let you message them - it invites them to message you. You can also message community groups in your neighbourhood.
